title: closeLoop
responsibility: Abandons a loop only when it still has pending steps, updates its closure timestamp and trace, and leaves step states unchanged.

inputs.name: closeLoopAbandoned.input
inputs.description: Loop directory identity and abandonment reason; root and timestamp provider are optional through LoopInput.

outputs.name: closeLoopAbandoned
outputs.description: Updated loop state and relative trace path after marking an open loop abandoned; step status and evidence remain unchanged.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Loop name/reason validation, missing/invalid state, identity mismatch, already closed, no pending steps.
